title: Rethinking Quantum Circuits
summary: These notes develop four interconnected ways of reading a quantum circuit. A circuit for us begins as an operational composition of gates; then, it becomes a diagram whose local equalities may be used as calculations; next, it becomes a protected process once errors, syndromes, and logical degrees of freedom are separated; and finally, it becomes geometric when its connectivity, topology, and boundary data are treated as physical design parameters.
